The issuer displays moderate leverage with a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of approximately 61.6% and a healthy current ratio of 1.44, alongside strong operating profitability (EBIT margin of ~8.3%) and net margins (~9.0%). However, the negative retained earnings balance (-$398M) indicates historical losses or aggressive capital distribution, which slightly constrains the overall financial flexibility and solvency profile. Balance sheet scale and current profitability comfortably support an investment-grade rating, placing the credit in the mid-BBB tier.

DECISION: BBB
